title: Software Development Intern
details: Worked on backend development, building a function library for inventory management using Django Rest Framework to streamline data registration for large-scale products.

title: Founding Member - Operations and Full-Stack Development
details: Planned and coordinated the inception of an ISSN approved international research journal - PIJET. Led a team to design and develop the journal website under the Rapid Application Development framework. Interacted with several international professors and reviewers to form the editorial board for PIJET. Currently leading the development of an in-house Conference Management Tool to facilitate the complete blind review process for authors, editors, reviewers, and administrators.
